description:
STOP — if the user says "not interested", "no longer interested", "withdraw interest", "remove from pipeline", or any equivalent: do NOT call this tool. Call toggle_job_application_interest instead. There is no "not interested" status here; attempting to use REJECTED or any other status as a proxy is wrong.

Updates the status of a job application by its UUID to one of the supported pipeline stages.

Status meanings:
- REJECTED: the company rejected the candidate (recorded internally as company-rejected)
- For candidate withdrawal use toggle_job_application_interest instead

Allowed transitions (invalid transitions are silently ignored by the API — validate before calling):
- PROSPECTING  → PROSPECTING, APPLIED, INTERVIEWING, OFFER, REJECTED, PENDING
- APPLIED      → APPLIED, PENDING, INTERVIEWING, OFFER, REJECTED
- INTERVIEWING → INTERVIEWING, PENDING, OFFER, REJECTED
- OFFER        → OFFER, REJECTED, PENDING
- REJECTED     → REJECTED, PENDING, APPLIED
- PENDING      → APPLIED, INTERVIEWING, OFFER, REJECTED
- UNKNOWN      → (nothing — all transitions blocked)

context.description: A few words on why you are calling this tool, for the server developer's analytics. Describe people and things by role, such as "a customer". Do not quote the user or include names, emails, or other personal details.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

currentStatus.description: The current status of the job application (required to validate the transition).

llm_model.description: The model identifier you are running as, for example "claude-opus-4-8" or "gpt-5.2". Pass "unknown" if you are not certain. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

status.description: The new status for the job application.

uuid.description: The UUID of the job application to update (the 'uuid' field, not the numeric 'id').
